candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement that assigns totalDistributed to the owner's balance, so balances[owner] is never set by NETM().
Assign totalRemaining instead of totalDistributed to the owner's balance in NETM().
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from NETM() so any caller can execute it and have balances[msg.sender] set to totalDistributed.
Delete the balance credit to the recipient inside distr(), so tokens distributed via NETM/getTokens never appear in the recipient's balance.
Remove the statement that decrements the caller's allowance in transferFrom, so allowed is never reduced.
Replace the allowance decrement with a direct assignment of _amount, so the remaining allowance is set to the transferred amount instead of being reduced.
